title: Island digital-twin composition question (cross-pillar assembly)
question: Develop an island digital twin: metabolic flow models on a realistic 3D model of an island, for participatory sustainability planning

A-metabolism.instructions: Your research lane is pillar A: island & urban metabolism — the flow layer (metabolic flow analysis, material/energy/water/waste stocks and flows of islands). Concepts to seed with: 'island metabolism', 'urban metabolism'. If the trace co-locates nothing at min_seeds=3, drop to 2, then use knowledge_query per concept.

B-3d-standards.instructions: Your research lane is pillar B: 3D city models & standards — the geometric + data substrate (CityGML, the Energy ADE, 3D city model state of the art). Concepts to seed with: 'city model', 'energy ade'.

C-digital-twins.instructions: Your research lane is pillar C: digital twins — the container (urban theory twin debates, island twin practice such as the Inishmore peer-to-peer energy twin, EU policy). Concept to seed with: 'digital twin'.

D-geodesign.instructions: Your research lane is pillar D: participatory planning support & geodesign — the decision process. Concept to seed with: 'participatory'.
